title: Buildings and industry
description: Cut the fossil fuel burnt in buildings and in steel, cement and chemical plants: its CO₂, the methane leaked supplying it and its air pollution, whose cooling goes too.

efficientBuildings.title: Efficient buildings
efficientBuildings.description: Insulation, better windows, and efficient appliances and lighting cut the fuel buildings burn and the electricity they use. At full adoption, both fall by 42%, which leaves less for heat pumps and clean power to replace.

cleanHeating.title: Clean heating
cleanHeating.description: Heat pumps and electric cooking replace gas and oil boilers: their CO₂ goes, the grid's CO₂ for running them comes.

cleanIndustry.title: Clean industry
cleanIndustry.description: Steel made with hydrogen or scrap in electric furnaces, cement with its kilns' CO₂ captured, and chemicals made with electrolytic hydrogen or carbon capture; the electricity they draw counts. Ammonia is left to the farm practices.

acidN2o.title: Nitric and adipic acid N₂O
acidN2o.description: Catalysts and thermal destruction break down the N₂O that nitric acid plants (for fertiliser) and adipic acid plants (for nylon) release. At 100%, 72% of nitric acid plants' N₂O and 96% of adipic acid plants' goes (IPCC).
